decision: Run once from the ordinary original course training archive only if the new anonymous comparison and the different-modality transfer both finish, the challenger's fresh course-development predictions do not lose accuracy to its own protected model, and both alias/feedback sensitivity tests pass. This is a check of unconstrained autonomous operation with a larger global allowance, not another read of the course validation answers.
inputs: Use the exact training archive, same release resource directory and same label-free 940-row input as the reproducible 710 submission. No named methods, prior election, special scheduler argument or Task2 features supplied to solve. Use the new source with only numeric allowances of 32 total local supervised fits and 1800 seconds. Permit access to the course archive's README and training CSV only. Independently reload and predict without the feature cache.
report: Report all fits, the actual optional nomination/weight and two previously unscored training checks if attempted. Compare all 940 ordered outputs with the corrected 710 submission. Identical output carries 710; different output has unknown designated-validation accuracy. Do not infer it from how many predictions changed, do not tune or rerun on the answer difference. The school test and H2 remain closed. Hold the submission branch fixed.
usage: At most one 32-fit cold solve. Zero model API requests.
